answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 94 identities per epoch. Audits are written down in voyage, queued in walnut, and dune publishes the wait time. A farm of 268 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1736 identities would post 4695 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
